notes:
Lead came in via organic search + blog (teachers using chat assistants). Founder (Elena Park) is primary decision maker; CTO (Ravi Patel) technical lead. Key context: small K-12 focused startup building a teacher-facing copilot to summarize classroom transcripts, generate differentiated lesson prompts, and flag student safety issues. Budget: very constrained — wants to keep hosted costs under ~$500/month initially.

Requirements / asks observed during calls:
- Use-case: classroom copilot (session-based chat), automated moderation on student messages, lightweight summarization for teacher notes. Mostly text workloads, occasional short audio transcripts (transcribed upstream).
- Latency target: interactive UX — acceptable p95 ~500-800ms for student-facing quick replies; teacher workflows can tolerate higher latency.
- Throughput: low-medium (hundreds of requests/day), but bursty during class hours.
- Model preference: open to small/medium open models to save cost; wants ability to route to cheaper fallback when budget alarms trigger.
- Security: Google Workspace SSO integration mandatory for teacher accounts; wants basic audit logs and retention controls. SOC2 not required immediately but they "want a path to it" as they scale.
- Data residency: US preferred but not strict for now.

What we demo'd / proposed:
- Hosted API with per-token pricing + example batching suggestions to reduce cost per session. Showed automatic prefix caching for teacher profiles. Proposed trial cap of $200 in credits to validate 2 weeks of usage.
- Safety: recommended Redwood's moderation pipeline as early integration; simple webhook to forward flagged events to teacher dashboard.

Quotes / paraphrases from calls:
- "We need something that works out of the box — we don't have SRE to run models." (Elena)
- "If we can't keep monthly inference costs < $500 early on, we won't get past pilots." (CTO)

Open items / blockers:
- Customer needs final confirmation on SSO flow (GSuite) and an integration checklist (asked for sample SAML metadata).
- Finance: needs a 3-month pricing forecast by Apr to get exec approval (budget gate).
- Consent: legal to confirm teacher & guardian notice for storing transcripts (mentions state regs).
